title: Nutty Velvety Mexican Prawns Carnitas-Style
description: A rich and comforting Mexican dish featuring brine-dry tiger prawns with a nutty and velvety carnitas-style sauce, perfect for a sick day. This low-carb-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional carnitas.
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ancho chili powder and cumin. Cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the coconut cream and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the sauce is simmering, cook the tiger prawns in a separate skillet over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Once the sauce has thickened, add the cooked prawns and stir to combine.
Season the sauce with salt and lime juice to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
